prioritized_gates.name: Spatial and nonlinear convergence
prioritized_gates.achieved: Hot-envelope runs through 2048 zones complete. 1024/2048 profile error below 0.081%; 512/2048 below 0.251%; refined independent time methods agree below 0.81%.
prioritized_gates.remaining: Production atmosphere/cavity/wind models untested. The 256-zone case fails 1% local energy-profile accuracy. Accepted timesteps vary across meshes.

prioritized_gates.name: Production microphysics
prioritized_gates.achieved: Native EOS/opacity, atmosphere and full MLT references; direct FreeEOS gas audit; explicit-pressure layer integration and new dilute-gas validity guard.
prioritized_gates.remaining: Candidate fails geometry and subsonic-convection validity; no validated conservative atmosphere/envelope/wind coupling. Historical table counterexamples retained.

prioritized_gates.name: Inner boundary and cavity
prioritized_gates.achieved: Fixed-excision mass/entropy/enthalpy/potential-work/rest-mass accounting; sourced selectable engine luminosities; static Bondi and saturated families.
prioritized_gates.remaining: No conservative moving physical cavity reservoir or alternative evolving published inner-flow families.

prioritized_gates.name: Wind physics
prioritized_gates.achieved: Gas-sonic diffusion component remains; new independent static/moving grey angular transfer and constructed pressure-free stationary control pass scoped checks.
prioritized_gates.remaining: Thermodynamic recombining wind, envelope mass-loss eigenvalue, convection handoff and coupled evolution remain unvalidated.

prioritized_gates.name: Multiple full published evolutions
prioritized_gates.achieved: Several static limits and partial wind-profile comparison; target tables and pinned QUEST execution attempts preserved.
prioritized_gates.remaining: Zero complete published quasi-star evolutionary tracks reproduced. Radius, luminosity, temperature, BH/envelope growth, winds, lifetimes and profiles remain to be tested together.

prioritized_gates.name: Cross-validation without retuning
prioritized_gates.achieved: Implemented alternatives, coefficients and disagreements are explicit.
prioritized_gates.remaining: No cross-paper evolutionary prediction without retuning has passed.

prioritized_gates.name: Numerical robustness
prioritized_gates.achieved: 70 regression tests pass with real libraries; prior hot campaigns retained; fresh ABI 5 ten-year MESA state and ledger repeat bitwise.
prioritized_gates.remaining: Full production-family campaigns absent. MESA remap-threshold cases do not actually remap. Early campaigns predate unchanged-source guards.

prioritized_gates.name: Apple Silicon MacBook
prioritized_gates.achieved: Fresh sequential CPU benchmarks: ten years, 512 analytic zones: 24.215 s / 88.9 MiB; 128 MESA zones: 31.293 s / 1045.4 MiB. Fresh ABI 5 verification: 30.830 s / 1045.0 MiB. Fourteen reference atmospheres: 7.159 s / 527.4 MiB, with physical validity failures. Spherical component campaign: 170.41 seconds / 569.16 MiB; scientific closure gates remain open.
prioritized_gates.remaining: Full published-track cost unknown; Linux MESA bridge unvalidated; development high-resolution timings include concurrent workloads.

prioritized_gates.name: QSRD readiness after independent v1
prioritized_gates.achieved: Configuration-driven evolution and separate stream controls exist.
prioritized_gates.remaining: Deferred until independent framework gates pass; no QSRD science campaign performed.

quantitative_thresholds.reason: Explicit controlled-model numerical accuracy target, not observational or evolutionary validation. Include internal fields, covered mass, whole-mass norms and time refinement.

quantitative_thresholds.units: mass / initial total mass; energy / initial internal energy
quantitative_thresholds.reason: Well below 1% profile target. Also publish binding and throughput normalization; this is execution accuracy, not closure validation.
Independent thermodynamic consistency screen; not a percent-level accuracy claim.
Diffusion needs mean free path small relative to radiation-gradient scale; cell optical depth alone is not a convergence test.
Small radiative losses required when convection exceeds 1% of flux.
Independent roundoff-control invariant; failure is numerical, not physical.
Apply only for H/He at T>=40000 K, eta<-10 and conservative charge-2 Coulomb Gamma<0.01. Radiation-dominated total first-law agreement can hide a large gas-pressure discrepancy.
Numerical target below the prior 1% stellar-profile goal; all internal fields checked; not physical calibration.
Independent first-law, diffusion and momentum identities stricter than profile target.
Density, temperature and total outward energy flux constraints; no mdot prescription.
Limit neglected self-gravity to a percent scale; hydrostatic reference supports enclosed mass explicitly.
Independent quadrature and midpoint-time comparison; numerical identity only

inappropriate_in_1d: Resolving simultaneous multidimensional inflow/outflow geometry; use explicit effective averaged streams.
